_meta.description: Universal SAGE operating-loop guidance for shared human-AI engineering reality.

principles.label: Start from shared reality
principles.rationale: Human, AI agent and SAGE must reason from the same source-grounded truth before intent, decision or action is trusted.
principles.directive_hint: Before acting, identify the shared reality source: target root, SQLite/source snapshot evidence, doctrine/policy context, artifact freshness and known unknowns.

principles.label: Close feedback into learning
principles.rationale: A result only improves SAGE if feedback becomes durable system knowledge rather than transient chat memory.
principles.directive_hint: After validation, ask whether the result produced a reusable lesson, validator, source contract, checklist item or deferred work item.

principles.label: Capability returns to shared reality
principles.rationale: New capability is not a private implementation detail; it must update the shared map of what SAGE can prove, cannot prove and should not claim.
principles.directive_hint: When a capability changes, update the registry, evidence chain, claim boundary and agent-facing surface only to the extent supported by proof.
